title: Unit-normalized realization data and its explicit cohomology functors
statement: With the coefficient and native pair categories [def-sf-coefficient-endpoint-objects, def-sf-native-derived-pair-cohomology], Data consists of an additive ordinary realization to native ordinary derived sheaves, a shift structure and shift-compatible Frobenius comparison, constructibility of all cohomology objects, and an isomorphism at the constant unit. For a supplied Data, define pairs by transport along its Frobenius comparison, pairCohomology by composing with native ordinary pair cohomology, and cohomology by restricting to the full subcategory of constructible Weil sheaves. No realization is chosen in these definitions.
